description: Airlift-era Skytrain displayed beside the memorial. Berlin Airlift memorial on the former Rhein-Main Air Base at the southern edge of Frankfurt Airport; the aircraft stand in the open beside the monument.

Rolled out on 16 March 1945 and converted for civil use in February 1946; flew for Pan Am in 1948 but not on the airlift itself, then Swissair and Balair, and came to Frankfurt in 1988. Berlin Airlift memorial on the former Rhein-Main Air Base at the southern edge of Frankfurt Airport; the aircraft stand in the open beside the monument.
